message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0), plus two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a Reverse card is played. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color, the number, or the symbol of the top card on the discard pile. If you have a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you can play it at any time. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the top card** – it determines what you can play. 2. **Use Wild Draw Four wisely** – you can only play it if you have no other playable card of the current color. 3. **Watch your opponents’ “UNO” calls** – they’re a good indicator of how close they are to winning. 4. **Plan for reverses** – a Reverse card can change the flow of the game dramatically. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
